propositions: MCP agents cannot query plan-review attestation currency without provoking a refusal error, unlike CLI agents who can use `rebar review-plan <id> --status`
No MCP tool wraps `rebar.llm.plan_review_status()`, the library function that answers whether an attestation is current and ready for claim/transition
A new read-only MCP tool `plan_review_status` must be registered by `register_read_tools`, absent from write registrars, and delegating to the existing library function
The tool output model `PlanReviewStatusOut` must document the shape `{ok, verdict, reason, verified_at_sha, signed_at}` with a canonical JSON schema for MCP schema coverage validation
Generated documentation `docs/mcp-reference.md` must list the new tool in its read-only section without staleness
